mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars), rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong household demand that boosts corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS > 700000, HOUST rising (compared to prior month) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past three months indicates a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has fallen below 100 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an inflationary environment that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS stable or rising) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing expansion regime (INDPRO > 105), a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust supply chain activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO > 105, INDPRO rising (compared to prior month) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
